summary: The reset change would create the proposed coverage obligation if gzip support is enabled. The supplied evidence does not establish that build condition.
missing_information: The active condition around GZIP in deflate.h and the compiler definitions produced by the supplied configure and Makefile.in build path.

assessment.necessity_reason: The after source clears gzhead during reset, and the old harness cannot install a custom gzip header or reset a stream. Whether this is a supported obligation under the supplied build depends on whether GZIP is enabled; the defining guard and effective compiler definitions were not supplied.

before.requirement: Clear a previously installed custom gzip header with deflateResetKeep before the next deflate call.
before.reason: The complete before reset body does not clear gzhead. The initializer clears it only when creating the stream.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Initialization clears gzhead before any custom header can be installed.
This function installs the custom header whose state the frozen obligation concerns.

after.requirement: On a supported customized gzip stream, deflateResetKeep clears gzhead so the next deflate call emits the default gzip header.
after.reason: Reset clears gzhead and deflate has a default-header path when GZIP is enabled. The old harness has no customization or reset sequence, but the packet does not establish that the conditional gzip path is enabled by this build.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Gzip wrapper selection is conditional on GZIP.
A gzip stream can receive a custom header through this call.
When GZIP is enabled, a null gzhead selects default gzip header emission.
The supplied define is inside a conditional whose opening guard is absent.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Each accepted input runs one fresh compression sequence.
The build delegates configuration to configure before compiling.

assessment.comparison_reason: The frozen clearing behavior is absent before and present in the conditional after code. Its applicability to this target remains unresolved until the effective GZIP build condition is known.
missing_information: Provide the opening guard for GZIP in deflate.h and the effective compiler definitions from configure and Makefile.in.
